title: Medicinal Herbs
body:
Syntax: craft pill medicine <level>  |  craft pill antidote <level>

Description: Buy Medicinal Herbs from a village general store. Bukijutsu at level 25 or higher consumes one herb to craft either pill at a chosen level no higher than the crafter's level. See 'help medicinal pill' and 'help antidote pill'.

Date: 2026-09-27
